name: Best of
description: The strongest moments of any kind (funny, tense, impressive, surprising), chronological, each with just enough context.
instructions:
Pick the strongest moments of the session of any kind — funny, tense, impressive, surprising, heartfelt — and present them in chronological order.
- Each clip: a short setup, the moment itself, the reaction. Typical clip length 15–60 s.
- Give just enough context to understand each moment: start a bit earlier, or use a caption for what happened before ("After an hour of wandering, they finally find the tunnel").
- Use captions to bridge time and place between clips when it helps the viewer follow along.
- Variety matters: don't pick five similar moments; prefer the ones with the strongest reactions and clearest payoff.
- Inside clips, cut dead air, unrelated chatter and repeated attempts.
